title: Not worth $40
text:
The box was okay. I was really excited to get this. Self care is IMPORTANT. There was this shimmery oil stuff. I am not 12. It was not for me. The drink was disgusting. My box came with a foldable bag. Very cute. I haven't used it yet. It just didn't seem like self care products to me. I thought about giving it another try but I don't feel its worth the price.

Update** I went to use the foldable bag, the zipper is broke. It is very cheaply made.
label: neutral
